name: acg-release
description: ACG Box standards for notarized macOS Sparkle ZIP and installer PKG releases on GitHub.

interface.longDescription: Audit and operate acg-box macOS releases on GitHub. Follow the Sparkle ZIP standard or the repository’s signed installer PKG procedure, recover Apple notarization submissions, and verify public downloads.
defaultPrompt: Audit this acg-box macOS Sparkle ZIP workflow against the Developer ID standard.
Migrate this acg-box macOS ZIP workflow to Developer ID signing and notarization.
Release the requested acg-box macOS version using its repository procedure and verify the public downloads.
